from pathlib import Path
import importlib.util
p=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1792544661/attempts/14aed0dece444fbc9ee55e057cb0e219/system/state/workspace/programs/task-66dbb586.py')
p.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
source='''from collections import deque

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    seen = set()
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if grid[r][c] == 1 or (r,c) in seen:
                continue
            q = deque([(r,c)])
            seen.add((r,c))
            cells = []
            edge = False
            while q:
                y,x = q.popleft(); cells.append((y,x))
                if y == 0 or x == 0 or y == h-1 or x == w-1: edge = True
                for yy,xx in ((y-1,x),(y+1,x),(y,x-1),(y,x+1)):
                    if 0 <= yy < h and 0 <= xx < w and grid[yy][xx] != 1 and (yy,xx) not in seen:
                        seen.add((yy,xx)); q.append((yy,xx))
            if not edge:
                for y,x in cells: out[y][x] = 4
    return out
'''
p.write_text(source)
